documents.title: Polk County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 18 pages. Amounts are the Original Budget (Budget Summary Report, 2026 Accounting Year, printed 2/20/2026); the equal 'Actual Balance' column was used as a check column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
